mission_2.prediction: I would say A* and DFS because comparing the results of both in mission 1  A* had a shorter path length than DFS. This is because A* uses a heuristic to prioritize cells that are closer to the goal, while DFS follows one direction deeper before backtracking and exploring other directions. I predict that A* will finish sooner because it is guided toward the goal instead of exploring paths without considering how close they are to it.
mission_2.performance: For the constrained map A* had a status of succeeded an elapsed time of 89.084 seconds and a distance of 23.8555 m. DFS had a status of timeout an elapsed time of 179.9 seconds, and a distance of 40.5429 m. The results supported my prediction because A* finished faster than DFS while DFS reached the time limit before completing the trial. Looking at the attempt plots DFS made several back and forth turns through the narrow passage while A* followed a more direct route around the obstacles. This could explain why DFS took longer and traveled a greater distance.
mission_2.choice: I would choose A* as my delivery planner because it found a shorter path than DFS on the open map. A* had a path length of 13.5 m while DFS had a path length of 32 m. On the constrained map, both planners found a path length of 24.5 m. So both planners were able to find a path on both maps. I would choose A* because it can find shorter routes which means the delivery robot would not have to travel as far to reach its destination.
